$comment: Team logos for tools/logo_art.py. commons = logo file on Wikimedia Commons (public domain, licence recorded). file = a team's own logo from the author's folder (local.json "logo_folders"), kept out of git; these are the teams' trademarks and not covered by the pack's Creative Commons licences (see credits.txt). All are shown on a white plate so dark lettering stays readable on the game's dark screens. Maker and tyre logos are in bases/dtm-era4/art/logos.json. Persson's comes from the 2012 folder, the others from the 2013 one ("folder"). "team_tiles": "maker": the game shows team logos only as small list icons, where they can't be recognised, so the pack uses each team's maker emblem there (as on the TV graphics) and builds the team logos into build/art/<season>/team_logos only (not in the pack or git).
